# Final Plan

## Wave A — Reconciliation
- Verify current reconciliation modules and tests.
- Fix any structural/behavioral failures.
- Add a current-account authenticated health route only if route auth conventions are proven.

## Wave B — Startup performance
- Read `server/deps.js`, DosDB constructor/module graph, and concrete use sites.
- Extract or lazy-load only optional heavy capabilities proven unnecessary before HTTP readiness.
- Re-profile require time and isolated full startup.

## Wave C — Workflow continuity
- Trace real share/export/import/open-with patterns.
- Add one reusable cross-product handoff primitive if missing.
- Integrate only through small shared seams.

## Wave D — Accessibility/performance/product value
- Audit shared commerce/catalog/retention surfaces.
- Fix proven global regressions.
- Audit game and creator/developer premium capabilities, implementing only fulfillment-backed value.

## Wave E — Final proof
- Run full release baseline.
- Runtime-prove browser flows.
- Re-read every touched file.
- Write planned-vs-actual, remaining-work, and next-action ledgers.
